subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Blockchain in Sourcing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Blockchain in Sourcing usable.

hook.text: A diamond's journey from mine to ring is recorded on a blockchain. Every hand it passed through is visible.

buildup.text: Blockchain creates an immutable ledger that tracks goods and transactions across the supply chain.

discovery.text: It enables verified provenance, tamper-proof records, and trust between parties who don't know each other.

twist.text: Blockchain can't verify what happens off-chain. If someone enters false data, the ledger records a perfect lie.

climax.text: De Beers, Walmart, and Maersk use blockchain to trace products from origin to consumer.

punchline.text: Blockchain records truth—if truth is entered.

quiz.question: What is blockchain's main limitation in supply chains?
options: It can't verify accuracy of off-chain inputs
